text:
For anyone who SIGNED UP and is going to NCCI data center trip we need to get there before 5:30 so try to get there by 5:20

📍 Address: 901 Peninsula Corporate Circle, Boca Raton, FL 33487
🕔 Arrive 5:00–5:30 PM — tour starts around 5:30
🚗 Parking: Park on site — carpool or drive yourself, there's plenty of room in the main lot at the main entrance.
🔑 Getting in: There are three parking-lot entrances — always go to the SECOND entrance. Hit the button on the call box and Security will answer. Once the gate opens, go right to park, or around the circle to park on the left. The building entrance is under the large covered awning.
🪪 Bring a photo ID and dress business casual (no shorts/flip-flops).

author: shaamad
text:
📢 Weekly Announcement — Cyber Club (Week of Oct 6) 🦉🔐

Big week! Two things going on 👇

🏢 TUESDAY 10/6 — NCCI Data Center Tour (Boca Raton)
If you signed up, this is tomorrow! Here's everything you need:

📍 Address: 901 Peninsula Corporate Circle, Boca Raton, FL 33487
🕔 Arrive 5:00–5:30 PM — tour starts around 5:30
🚗 Parking: Park on site — carpool or drive yourself, there's plenty of room in the main lot at the main entrance.
🔑 Getting in: There are three parking-lot entrances — always go to the SECOND entrance. Hit the button on the call box and Security will answer. Once the gate opens, go right to park, or around the circle to park on the left. The building entrance is under the large covered awning.
🪪 Bring a photo ID and dress business casual (no shorts/flip-flops).

If you can no longer make it, let me know ASAP so I can update the headcount.

💻 THURSDAY 10/8 — Infrastructure Showcase + Practice Competition! | 5–7 PM | CM 22, Room 125
Come see the infrastructure we've been building — and if all goes well, we're running a practice competition on campus! 🏆 Whether you're new or experienced, come get hands-on. This is great prep for CCDC/NCAE season.

📅 Coming up — guest speakers start next week:

10/15 — Zachary Bright, Red Team Manager @ ADT
10/22 — Kyle Ryan, Red Team Manager @ NextEra Energy
10/29 — Delia Drumm, Senior Technical Manager @ Microsoft

Questions? Drop 'em here or DM me. See you this week! 🚀

: WRCCDC #1 is tomorrow! The event is from 12 AM - 8 PM! Little Ceasers *PIZZA* 🍕 will be served during the competitions. If you prefer to bring your own laptops you can though you will need to install the VPN its in the packet, check the for more information or ask for more help somewhere. 

Come by around 11:00ish to get situated so we can also explain how the competition goes down. This is PRACTICE no experience is required just passion. ROOM-150 Building CM-122 Behind the library
(I got a internship after doing these competitions! LOCK IN!)

author: shaamad
text:
📢 Club Today — Starting at 6 PM!
Heads up: today's meeting starts at 6 PM instead of 5 due to some scheduling stuff on my end. Sorry for the short notice!
🛡️ Still on for today: CyberPatriot Practice Images
We're still doing practice images; come secure some VMs with us! Bring your laptop 💻
📊 Practice images: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cdVHtk4w5JDJCYy-EO2_ycr0ZqMgUyjFOVDn5Y8eGVw/edit?gid=735920429
💿 VMware installers: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Lf7qnJSXf9q1KHE8IzPvySEZRyUHutfL

👉 Which images to grab:
🐧 Linux: Age of Pirates
🪟 Windows: Jason *or* Santa's Workshop

To load: unzip, then double-click the .vmx file (looks like a text file) — it imports straight into VMware.
🍎 Mac users: VMware Fusion can work, but it's iffy (especially on M-series Macs), so it's best to pair up with a Windows user.
🏢 Reminder: NCCI Data Center Tour — Next Tue, Oct 6
📝 PLEASE FILL OUT THE FORM to lock your spot — spots are limited!
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc_l3btxSU0p6k9FXOoWLNUjA354A0cXY1pS4WTIWWJMlPrKg/viewform
🪪 Government-issued ID required (student ID is NOT enough).
🤔 Question: Do we want to do WRCCDC?
We've got a ton of competitions lined up, so I want your take. WRCCDC would be good practice, but we'll have 3 more shots at practice before CCDC season starts, and honestly our setup isn't ideal for it right now (VPNs, hardware, etc.).
So — worth doing anyway, or save our energy for the others? Drop your vote/thoughts below! 👇 If enough people are down, we'll make it happen.
